name: Canvas Engine UI
description: UI interaction spec for the infinite canvas engine. Core spatial interaction model: pan, zoom, card lifecycle, grid rendering, arrangement controls.

interactions.name: pan
interactions.trigger: Left-click drag on empty canvas area
interactions.behavior: Update panX/panY with delta from start position, throttled via requestAnimationFrame

interactions.name: zoom
interactions.behavior: Cursor-centered zoom — world point under cursor stays under cursor. zoom = clamp(zoom + direction * step, 0.1, 5.0)

interactions.name: zoom_lock
interactions.trigger: Click lock icon in status bar or View > Zoom > Lock
interactions.behavior: Set canvas.locked to true, disables all zoom/pan interactions until unlocked

interactions.name: add_card
interactions.behavior: Create PluginCard with plugin instance, snap to 28px grid, position at default offset or cascaded, push to z-order top, focus

interactions.name: card_focus
interactions.behavior: Move card's UUID to end of zOrder array, increment z-index

interactions.name: card_close
interactions.trigger: Click terminate button (X) on card header
interactions.behavior: Remove card from canvas, destroy plugin instance, fire onStateChange

interactions.name: card_minimize
interactions.trigger: Click minimize button (—) on card header
interactions.behavior: Hide card body, set isOpen=false, update TopBar menu item to show dimmed

interactions.name: card_reopen
interactions.trigger: Click dimmed plugin item in TopBar View menu
interactions.behavior: Restore card to saved position and dimensions, set isOpen=true

interactions.name: fit_all_viewport
interactions.trigger: Click status bar 'view all' button or double-click card header
interactions.behavior: Calculate bounding box of all visible cards, compute zoom to fit with 40px padding, animate pan to center

interactions.name: auto_arrange
interactions.behavior: Tile all open cards in a grid layout, default 2 columns, 800x550 sizing. Cards sorted by uuid for deterministic layout.

interactions.name: tile_plugins
interactions.trigger: Set WxH inputs in arrangement panel, click 'Tile Plugins'
interactions.behavior: Apply custom width/height to all open cards, re-arrange in grid. Shrinks to fit if needed (min 2 cols).

interactions.name: auto_fit_all
interactions.trigger: Click 'Auto Fit All' in arrangement panel
interactions.behavior: Sort open cards by usageCount descending. Divide viewport into ceil(N/3) equal-height horizontal bands. Each band holds up to 3 cards: first gets left 50% of band, second gets top-right 25%, third gets bottom-right 25%. Bands with 2 cards split equally (50/50 width). Bands with 1 card fill entire band. Sets zoom=1 and locks canvas.

interactions.name: right_click_empty
interactions.behavior: ContextMenu with: New Terminal, New Explorer, New Git, New Markdown

interactions.name: snap_to_grid
interactions.trigger: All card position changes (drag end, auto arrange)

interactions.name: animated_pan
interactions.behavior: Ease-out cubic interpolation over 300ms: t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3)

states.default: Grid visible (dots by default), zoom at 1.0, no cards
states.cards_open: One or more PluginCards visible with z-order stacking
states.minimized: Card header visible but body hidden, isOpen=false
states.locked: Zoom and pan disabled, lock icon shown in status bar
states.arranging: Cards being repositioned by auto-arrange, temporary transition state
